questions.q: Find the mean of $6,9,12,15,18$.
Ages of 7 students: $13,15,13,16,14,13,17$. Find the mean, median, and mode.
questions.answer: Ordered: $13,13,13,14,15,16,17$. Mean $=\dfrac{101}{7}\approx14.43$. Median (4th value) $=14$. Mode $=13$ (appears three times).

questions.q: Find the range and mode of the data set $8,3,8,15,8,22,3$.
A data set has mean $18$ and 6 values. Find the sum of the values.
The data set $10,12,11,13,50$ contains an outlier. Find the mean before and after removing $50$.
A data set of 5 values has mean $20$. Four of the values are $15,18,22,25$. Find the fifth value.
questions.answer: Total sum $=20\times5=100$. Known sum $=15+18+22+25=80$. Fifth value $=100-80=20$.

questions.q: A survey of 50 people's favorite fruit: Apple 15, Banana 12, Orange 10, Mango 13. What fraction of people chose banana?
Using the same survey (Apple 15, Banana 12, Orange 10, Mango 13, out of 50), what percent chose either apple or mango?
A table shows quiz scores: score 5 (3 students), score 7 (5), score 8 (8), score 9 (4), score 10 (2). Find the mode score and the total number of students.
questions.answer: Mode $=8$ (8 students, the highest frequency). Total students $=3+5+8+4+2=22$.

questions.q: Using the same quiz data, find the mean score to two decimal places.
The bar chart shows books sold by genre in one week. Find the total books sold and the modal (most common) genre.
questions.answer: Total $=45+30+20+15=110$ books. The modal genre is Fiction, with $45$ books.

questions.q: Using the same book-sales data, what percent of total books sold were mystery novels, to the nearest percent?
The bar chart shows monthly rainfall in mm. Find the mean monthly rainfall.
Using the same rainfall data (Jan 60, Feb 45, Mar 80, Apr 55 mm), find the percent decrease from March to April.
A bag holds 4 red and 6 blue marbles. Find $P(\text{red})$.
A fair six-sided die is rolled. Find $P(\text{a number greater than }4)$.
A card is drawn from a standard deck of 52 cards. Find $P(\text{a heart})$.
A spinner has 8 equal sections numbered 1 to 8. Find $P(\text{an even number})$.
A bag holds 3 red, 5 blue and 2 green marbles. Find $P(\text{not red})$.
Two fair coins are tossed. Find $P(\text{both land heads})$.
A die is rolled twice. Find $P(\text{both rolls show a }6)$.
A bag holds 4 white and 6 black balls. One ball is drawn and not replaced, then a second is drawn. Find $P(\text{both white})$.
A class of 9 students has an average score of 80. A 10th student joins with a score of 100. Find the new average for all 10 students.
questions.answer: Old sum $=80\times9=720$. New sum $=720+100=820$. New average $=\dfrac{820}{10}=82$.

questions.q: Class A has 20 students with mean score $75$; Class B has 30 students with mean score $85$. Find the overall mean of all 50 students.
A student's final grade is $40\%$ homework average (score $90$) and $60\%$ exam average (score $70$). Find the weighted final grade.
A survey combines two groups: 15 people with average age $24$, and 25 people with average age $32$. Find the overall average age of all 40 people.
Data set A: $10,12,14,16,18$. Data set B: $8,14,14,14,20$. Both have the same mean. Which has the greater range?
questions.answer: Both have mean $14$. Range of A $=18-10=8$. Range of B $=20-8=12$. Data set B has the greater range (more spread out).

questions.q: Team X scored $22,25,28,25$ points in 4 games. Team Y scored $20,20,35,25$. Both teams have the same mean score. Which team's scores are more consistent (smaller range)?
questions.answer: Both have mean $25$. Range of X $=28-22=6$. Range of Y $=35-20=15$. Team X is more consistent.

questions.q: Class 1 has 18 students with mean score $68$; Class 2 has 22 students with mean score $74$. Find the combined mean of all 40 students, to one decimal place.
A teacher records the number of siblings for 10 students: $1,2,0,1,3,2,1,0,2,1$. Find the mean, median, and mode.
questions.answer: Sum $=13$, mean $=\dfrac{13}{10}=1.3$. Ordered: $0,0,1,1,1,1,2,2,2,3$; median $=\dfrac{1+1}{2}=1$. Mode $=1$ (appears four times).

questions.q: A company's weekly sales (in thousands of riyals) over 5 weeks: $40,55,35,60,50$. Find the mean weekly sales, and state how many weeks had sales above the mean.
questions.answer: Mean $=\dfrac{240}{5}=48$ thousand riyals. Weeks above the mean: $55,60,50$ — that is $3$ weeks.

questions.q: A jar contains 5 red, 3 blue and 2 yellow candies. A candy is picked and eaten, then another is picked. Find $P(\text{first red, then blue})$.
In a survey of 200 students, 120 prefer math and the rest prefer science. Find the probability, as a percent, that a randomly chosen student prefers science.

The data set $14,16,15,17,60$ contains an outlier. Find the mean before and after removing $60$.
questions.answer: Before: sum $=122$, mean $=24.4$. After removing $60$: sum $=62$ over $4$ values, mean $=15.5$.

questions.q: A data set of 6 values has mean $25$. Five of the values are $20,22,28,30,32$. Find the sixth value.
questions.answer: Total needed $=6\times25=150$; sum of five $=132$; sixth $=150-132=18$.

questions.q: The bar chart shows quiz scores. Find the total number of students, and the modal score.
questions.answer: Total $=2+4+6+5+3=20$; the score $8$ has the highest frequency ($6$ students).

A table shows the number of pets owned by 25 families: $0$ pets (6 families), $1$ pet (10), $2$ pets (7), $3$ pets (2). Find the median number of pets.
questions.answer: With $25$ values sorted, the median is the $13$th value, which falls in the '$1$ pet' group.

questions.q: Using the same pet data, find the mean number of pets per family, to two decimal places.
The bar chart shows books sold by genre in one week. Find the total books sold, and the modal genre.
questions.answer: Total $=45+30+25+20=120$; Fiction had the most sales ($45$).

The bar chart shows quarterly sales for four stores, in thousands of riyals. Find the range, and which store had the highest sales.
questions.answer: Range $=140-85=55$; Store D had the highest sales ($140$).

questions.answer: Both have mean $16$. Range A $=8$; range B $=13$. B has the greater range.

questions.q: Team X scored $18,22,25,23$ points in 4 games. Team Y scored $15,15,32,26$. Both teams have the same mean. Which team is more consistent (smaller range)?
questions.answer: Both have mean $22$. Range X $=7$; range Y $=17$. Team X is more consistent.

questions.q: Class 1 has 16 students with mean score $70$; Class 2 has 24 students with mean score $80$. Find the combined mean of both classes.
Data set A: $5,10,15,20,25$. Data set B: $13,14,15,16,17$. Both have mean $15$. Which has the smaller range, and what is it?
questions.answer: Range A $=20$; range B $=4$. Data set B is smaller.

questions.q: Two data sets both have median $20$. Set P: $10,15,20,25,30$. Set Q: $18,19,20,21,22$. Which set is more spread out?
questions.answer: Range P $=20$; range Q $=4$. Set P is more spread out.

A survey of 150 shoppers found 90 prefer online shopping and the rest prefer in-store. Find the probability, as a fraction in simplest form, that a randomly chosen shopper prefers in-store.
questions.answer: In-store $=60$ out of $150$, which simplifies to $\dfrac{2}{5}$.
